muhumuhu: [Muhuṃ] (bya) CL=7 [Vicchāpada.] Repeatedly. Again and again. Moment by moment.
mukhakoṭimasa: [Mukhakoṭi+maṃsa] (na) CL=7 The flesh or meat of the tip of the mouth.
munindacandasaddhammarasī: [Munindacanda+saddhammaraṃsī] (thī) CL=7 The aureole that is the wholesome dhamma of Buddha who is as bright as a moon.
muyheyyu: [Muha+ya+eyyuṃ] (kri) CL=7 They will be unconscious. See - Muyhati.
muñceyyu: [Muca+a+eyyuṃ] (kri) CL=7 They should release. See - Muñcati-(2-A).
muñcissa: [Muca+a+ssaṃ] (kri) CL=7 I will release. See - Muñcati-(2-A).
muñcisu: [Muca+a+hi] (kri) CL=7 May they release. See - Muñcati-(2-A).
muṇḍesu: [Muṇḍa+uṃ] (kri) CL=7 They shaved. They made a clean-shaven head. See - Muṇḍati.
